title: Recommendations and suitability comments
summary: This topic centers on whether reviewers would recommend the car, often tied to comfort, ease of driving, fuel economy, features, or buyer-specific fit.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car is comfortable, easy to drive, well equipped, fuel efficient, and recommendable to many buyers.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention recommendation, suitability, or rhetorical concerns, but the short fragments do not provide enough context to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short or truncated, which limits confidence about the reviewer’s full sentiment.
This cluster mixes direct recommendations with broader suitability comments and rhetorical statements, so the topic is not fully coherent from the available examples.
Some assigned sentiments appear counterintuitive relative to the fragment text, so the summary follows the provided labels rather than reclassifying them.
